raw_comment:
I noticed that there are significantly more droughts on the right side of the Rocky Mtn. region and in the middle of the US. I also noticed that areas near the coast had significantly less droughts than those around no or little water.

I wonder what causes the dry regions when they are located in the middle of the nation. I also wonder how the land near the Great Lakes region is experiencing drought since they are around large bodies of water.

Drought can impact the quality of the soil which affects crop growth/yield. Many of these crops are used to create different produce and foods in stores that are local to me. Since there may be little product, there would be inflation and possibly overconsumption by consumers.

Second Thoughts to Droughts: Tracking Drought Severity in America
